---
title: "Weekly TRACE Labs"
---

Every ordinary teaching week follows:

> **Prepare → Quiz → TRACE Lab → Task → Next on DSA261**

## Phase I — Know, Search, Question

### [Week 1 — How Do You Know?](weeks/week01.qmd)
Information seeking, source tracing, and verification.

### [Week 2 — Who Decides What You See?](weeks/week02.qmd)
Ranking, recommendation, targeting, and computational propaganda.

### [Week 3 — Is This AI?](weeks/week03.qmd)
Automation, predictive AI, generative AI, and claim auditing.

## Phase II — Understand and Stress-Test AI

### [Week 4 — What Does an LLM Actually Do?](weeks/week04.qmd)
Prediction, tokens, attention, context, and model variability.

### [Week 5 — Can AI Make You Better?](weeks/week05.qmd)
Capability boundaries, benchmarks, skill boosting, and verification cost.

### [Week 6 — When Algorithms Decide About People](weeks/week06.qmd)
Risk scores, bias, fairness, and counterfactual probing.

## Midterm

### [Week 7 — TRACE Midterm Challenge](weeks/week07.qmd)
An original evidence-based investigation integrating Weeks 1–6.

## Phase III — Use, Control, Verify

Weeks 8–11 will add prompt design, context management, hallucination verification, and academic integrity.

## Phase IV — Govern and Transfer

Weeks 12–14 will add context-specific guidelines, professional accountability, and final-project transfer.
